subject: HarborPay: continuity SLAs, dependency map & RPO attestation
messages:
From: Cassidy Ruiz <cassidy.ruiz@harborpay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: HarborPay Security <security@harborpay.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: continuity dependency map + RTO/RPO attestation for procurement

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HarborPay is progressing toward a procurement review and our security team needs a short continuity package to complete the risk assessment. Specifically we need: 1) a dependency map showing which vendors and regions support our production inference path; 2) an RTO/RPO attestation for the deployed configuration we discussed (hosted inference with warm-cache enabled, multi-AZ failover); and 3) copies or excerpts of the operator runbook that describe failover steps and exercises.

Key asks (can you confirm these are available?):
- RTO measurement methodology and recent test windows (warm start, failover, cold restore)
- RPO values by service tier and an example telemetry trace for a warm start
- A short list of on-call contacts and roles or a redacted operator roster we can keep on file
- Any SLA exceptions or scheduled maintenance windows that would affect our procurement counts

We'd like the package by next Friday (2028-03-30) to keep our procurement calendar on track. If some items require redaction for security reasons, a note about what was redacted and why is fine.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30 min call if that helps.

Best,
Cassidy Ruiz
Director, Security & Compliance
HarborPay

Attachments: none (initial request)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Cassidy Ruiz <cassidy.ruiz@harborpay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity dependency map + RTO/RPO attestation for procurement

Hi Cassidy — thanks for the clear list. We're on it and can deliver a redacted package for procurement. Plan below and asks for you: 

What we'll deliver by 2028-03-29 (one day ahead of your deadline):
- BCP_RPO_matrix_v1.csv — table with RTO/RPO by component (hosted API, embeddings pipeline, KV cache), last test date, and owner.
- runbook_snapshot_20280301.pdf — curated excerpts (failover checklist, rollback criteria) with internal URLs redacted.
- operator_roster_redacted.xlsx — role-level roster (names redacted to role+team) and escalation steps.
- kv_warm_cache_traces_stub.gz — anonymized trace showing a recent warm-start sequence and token-level latency markers.

Clarifying Qs (helps us format the attestation):
1) For the RTO attestation — do you need a signed attestation on HarborPay letterhead, or is a Redwoods-signed statement sufficient?
2) Does procurement need CAIQ/SIG mapping alongside the BCP docset, or is SIG handled in a separate questionnaire?

Operational items: Priyom will own the compilation and final QC; David will pull the KV/warm-cache traces and extract the timing windows; Marissa will redact and prepare the runbook excerpts. We can schedule a 30-min tabletop walkthrough on 2028-03-30 10:00am PT if that fits your team. If you prefer a different slot let us know.

I'll attach the initial matrix and snapshot in a secure Drive link once they're packaged. If you need DocuSign for the attestation, please send the link and I'll route to Legal.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Security Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to follow): BCP_RPO_matrix_v1.csv (draft), runbook_snapshot_20280301.pdf (excerpts)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity dependency map + RTO/RPO attestation for procurement

Stephanie — I'll take the KV/warm-cache traces. Work plan:
- Pull two warm-start runs (2028-02-27, 2028-03-12) and spike/extract the RTO window (kv-warm-init -> first-successful-token).
- Produce a stripped trace (no customer data) and a timing table showing median/95th percentiles for the warm-start sequence.
- Flag any known test anomalies or partial rollbacks.

I'll attach a stub of the trace bundle (kv_warm_cache_traces_stub.gz) to the package; full telemetry will be redacted and available under NDA if required. Also confirming I can extract operator-run IDs for the roster redaction.

— David
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kv_warm_cache_traces_stub.gz (stub — redacted)

On 2028-03-21 Stephanie Nguyen wrote:
> Hi Cassidy — thanks for the clear list. We're on it and can deliver a redacted package for procurement. Plan below and asks for you:...

From: Cassidy Ruiz <cassidy.ruiz@harborpay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: HarborPay Security <security@harborpay.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity dependency map + RTO/RPO attestation for procurement

Thanks — that timeline works. A couple of small follow-ups:

1) We do need a signed attestation that the RTO/RPO values reflect production failover behavior for the current deployed revision. HarborPay legal prefers a signed PDF (DocuSign is fine).
2) Please include any SLA carve-outs (maintenance blackout windows, known single-AZ exposure in eu-west-2 historically) as a short appendix.

I'll send the DocuSign link for the attestation to the secure Drive address you provide. Also please note procurement will ask for a brief cover note mapping the BCP artifacts to our SIG/CAIQ questions (they don't need the full questionnaire answered, just a mapping table).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can take the redacted artifacts internally and request any live witness if needed later.

Best,
Cassidy
Director, Security & Compliance
HarborPay

-----
HarborPay Security (security@harborpay.com) added as recipient to the thread for visibility.
